item.title: Norfolk councillor speaks out about 'derogatory remarks' made on social media site

item.title: Hagersville, Dunnville vie for ‘hometown takeover’ on new HGTV reality show
item.description: Two small towns in Haldimand County are among dozens of communities across Canada vying for a free glow-up courtesy of HGTV Canada.

item.title: Brantford Police warn public of extortion scam involving threatening messages, videos
item.description: The Brantford Police Service is advising members of the public about an extortion scam after receiving reports from victims who were targeted through threatening text messages. In reported incidents, victims received text messages containing threats of harm directed at them and their families.
